items.statement: Let E be any finite-dimensional real inner-product space, including dimension zero, with its Borel measurable structure. Let V:E→ℝ be C². Let α,β be nonnegative reals and η a real number satisfying α>0, α≤β, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v∈E, η>0, and βη≤1. Fix any y,xRef∈E and initial phase z0=(x0,p0)∈E×E. Set c=y−η∇V(xRef). For z=(x,p), define the actual harmonic flow Φ_t(z)=(c+cos(t)(x−c)+√η sin(t)p, −sin(t)(x−c)/√η+cos(t)p), reflection S(z)=(x,p−[2〈p,g(x)〉/‖g(x)‖²]g(x)), residual g(x)=∇V(x)−∇V(xRef), and rate λ(z)=√η max{0,〈p,g(x)〉}. The reflection uses total real division, hence is the identity when g(x)=0. Define Λ(z,t)=∫_0^t λ(Φ_s(z)) ds for finite t≥0 and τ(z,e)=inf{t≥0:Λ(z,t)≥e}, with inf empty=∞. Let P be the actual countable product of rate-one exponential Borel measures on Ω=ℝ^ℕ; let ε_k(sample)=max{sample_k,0} viewed as a nonnegative real. Define active records (T,z) and an absorbing stopped record carrying no phase. Initialize record0=(0,z0). At index k, a stopped record stays stopped; an active record (T,z) becomes stopped if τ(z,ε_k)=∞ and otherwise becomes (T+τ(z,ε_k), S(Φ_{τ(z,ε_k)}(z))). Its event time T_k is the finite time component if active and ∞ if stopped. Then for these fixed y,xRef,z0, for P-almost every sample, simultaneously: (i) for every finite nonnegative horizon t, all sufficiently large k satisfy t<T_k; (ii) for every such t the set {k∈ℕ:T_k≤t} is finite. Initialization index0 is included, and ε_k is source E_(k+1). The result includes both eventual stopping and infinite continuing paths with unbounded event times; it does not assert eventual stopping. It is an actual-input, fixed-reference nonaccumulation conclusion of Appendix A.1 Ex9, with ASTIS total-record and finite-index adapters. The global physical-time process and its additional properties are separate obligations.
assumptions: E is finite-dimensional real inner-product with its Borel measurable structure; no positive-dimension restriction. V is C² and α,β≥0.
The six exact source conditions are α>0; α≤β; V∈C²; for all x,v, α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖²; η>0; βη≤1. No third or higher derivative condition.

y,xRef,z0 are arbitrary deterministic parameters. P and ε are literal canonical definitions. No probability, iid, positivity, divergence, cap, energy, waiting-time or recurrence certificate is a public premise.

Threshold positivity and faithful clamp/raw equality hold simultaneously only almost surely. The all-finite-horizon conclusion is pathwise on the common good-input event for each fixed parameter triple; no uncountable intersection over triples is assumed.

Stopped records have eventTime=∞ with no phase at infinity. The statement counts indices including index0, not a physical bounce-count expectation. The author direct Exp mean-one strong-law route is distinct from the reused ASTIS bounded-indicator sufficient route.
